The Concurrency section of Server settings documents background_pool_size, which sets MergeTree background merge and mutation threads with a default of 16, and max_concurrent_queries, which limits simultaneous queries.

background_pool_size sets the number of threads performing background merges and mutations for tables with the MergeTree engine. The default value is 16.

max_concurrent_queries limits how many queries are processed simultaneously.

In the Parts section of the MergeTree engine documentation, a part is described as an immutable on-disk set of files holding a sorted range of rows that merges replace rather than modify.

A part is an immutable set of files on disk holding a sorted range of rows. Parts are never modified in place; a merge replaces several parts with one.
